import parse

# More edge cases for R2
# Test with various format specs using digit numbering
tests = [
    ('{0:d}', '42'),
    ('{0:f}', '3.14'),
    ('{0:x}', 'ff'),
    ('{0:o}', '77'),
    ('{0:b}', '1010'),
    ('{0:%}', '10%'),
    ('{0:w}', 'hello'),
    ('{0:>10}', '      hello'),
    ('{0:<10}', 'hello     '),
    ('{0:^10}', '  hello   '),
    ('{0:.>10}', '.....hello'),
    ('{0:05d}', '00042'),
    ('{0:10.2f}', '      3.14'),
    ('{1:d}', 'xx 42'),
    ('{0:w} {1:d}', 'hello 42'),
]

all_pass = True
for fmt, string in tests:
    try:
        r = parse.parse(fmt, string)
        if r is None:
            print(f'FAIL: {fmt!r} on {string!r} -> None')
            all_pass = False
        else:
            print(f'OK: {fmt!r} on {string!r} -> {r.fixed}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'FAIL: {fmt!r} on {string!r} -> {e}')
        all_pass = False

print()
print('All tests passed:', all_pass)
"
